# dsh-antigravity
English | 简体中文

Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for
DeepSeek Harness.

This plugin supports DSH Web and Desktop. It registers a DSH `LlmAdapter`
under provider route `anti

gravity`, stores OAuth credentials under DSH home,
talks to the Cloud Code Assist streaming API dire
ctly, and provides bilingual (English & Simplified Chinese) settings.

ves account-induced global pauses and adds one same-account, same-endpoint 429 retry. See CHANGELOG.
> v0.1.6 fixes generation/quota project-binding mismatches and stale refresh overwrites; the 0.1.5 r
equest policy is unchanged.
> v0.1.5 preserves Gemini tool schema references and adds conservative request handling, persistent
cooldowns, private credential writes and one version source. Historical tool-call/result pairing fro
m 0.1.4 is retained. See CHANGELOG.

> Unofficial integration. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by
> Google. Use it only w
ith accounts and services you are authorized to access.

## Multi-Account Pool & Login
Open **Settings > Antigravity** to manage Google Antigravity accounts:
- **Healthy account selection**: Chooses an available account before a new request. Manual mode uses

only the selected account; cooling or suspended accounts are excluded.
- **Independent limits**: A
429 cools only that account. With no wait hint or a wait up to 30 seconds, one retry is allowed on t
he same account/endpoint; a longer wait stops immediately. Default cooldown is 15 seconds. Quota-que
ry 429 records a quota error without cooling chat. A 401/403 suspends the affected account until rea

uthorization.
- **Backward Compatible**: Automatically migrates existing single `antigravity-oauth.j

son` into Account 1.
- **Frontend Image Generation Tool**: Integrates `antigravity_image_generate` t
o automatically generate web illustrations using `gemini-3.1-flash-image` into `./assets/images`.
Click **「＋ Add Google Account」** to append additional accounts into the pool.

## Request policy and tool compatibility
Generation performs at most **two HTTP attempts**. A 429 with a server wait above 30 seconds is not
retried. Otherwise it retries once on the same account and endpoint after the given wait or 2500ms w
hen none is supplied. Transport/500/502/503/504 retries retain their previous behavior. Once a succe
ssful response starts, a broken/partial stream is returned as an error, never replayed. An explicit
`ANTIGRAVITY_BASE_URL` remains pinned. There is no automatic cross-account retry; choose another acc
ount manually or let a new request choose a healthy one.
Gemini receives intact `$defs`/`definitions`, local `$ref` and nested/composed schemas. Bad/local-mi
ssing/external/anchor references fail locally, without network fetching. Preflight is bounded (128 J
SON nesting levels, 50,000 visited data units and 2 MiB across declarations) and is not a complete J
SON Schema validator.
Claude/GPT-OSS use restricted Legacy declarations: basic types, properties, required, items, descrip
tions and string enums; local references are expanded. A nullable single type uses its non-null type
as in the previous adapter. Unsupported constraints, unions, tuples and recursive structures fail *
*explicitly** rather than being silently removed. Complex MCP tool sets may require Gemini or disabl
ing incompatible declarations in the host.
Credential files are atomically replaced with mode `0600` where supported; symlink destinations are
refused. Ordinary request logs omit tokens, prompts, tool payloads and email addresses. The CLI sign
-in link is deliberately displayed to the local user for authorization; keep redirected login output
private. Local settings show emails to help identify accounts, but generation tool results use inte
Local settings show emails to help identify accounts, but generation tool results use internal IDs.
**Scope:** these are reliability/privacy protections, not client-identity camouflage or a guarantee
against account restrictions. Google can still associate requests with OAuth credentials. No authori
zation, region or quota restrictions are bypassed. Account cooldown persistence survives restart; in
dependent simultaneously running plugin hosts are not a distributed shared quota controller.
